art_note: The lifestyle gym imagery elevates the product significantly, though the flat mockups look cheap.
desc_en: Redefine your workout with a piece designed to stand out. The contrast of black stars against a white background delivers a graphic and modern aesthetic. Its high-rise silhouette sculpts the figure while offering secure support during movement. Crafted for the woman who demands presence both in the gym and on the street. Each piece is made to order and features worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Redefine tu entrenamiento con una pieza diseñada para destacar. El contraste de estrellas negras sobre fondo blanco aporta una estética gráfica y moderna. Su silueta de tiro alto esculpe la figura mientras ofrece un soporte seguro durante el movimiento. Confeccionados para la mujer que exige presencia tanto en el gimnasio como en la calle. Cada prenda se elabora bajo pedido y cuenta con envío mundial.
details_en:
· Soft-touch polyester fabric
· High-rise waist with wide waistband

· Black stars on white design, front DPF logo and rear graphic
· Made to order
details_es:
· Tejido de poliéster de tacto suave

· Diseño de estrellas negras sobre blanco, logotipo DPF delantero y gráfico trasero
